stem: A test's 95% confidence interval for the lift in conversion runs from -0.4 to +2.6 percentage points. A colleague says: "It crosses zero, so the change has no effect." What is the better reading?

options.text: Right: an interval that crosses zero shows the change has no effect
Inconclusive: the lift could be slightly negative or over 2 points
The change hurt conversion, since the interval starts below zero
The change worked, since most of the interval lies above zero
